messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the person's hairstyle to the one shown in the reference images, using the references only for the hairstyle shape. Preserve the person's identity, hair color, clothing, and all other aspects of the current video unchanged.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: I'd like to change the person's hairstyle to the one shown in the reference images. Use the reference images only for the hairstyle. Keep the person's identity, hair color, clothing, and all other aspects of the current video unchanged.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"She stands on the road, raises one arm to touch her hair, places the other hand on her hip, then turns and shifts her weight while posing.","camera":"Static, low-angle full-body shot from behind the subject.","clothing":"A short, tight dress with a dark green checkered bodice and a black skirt with a yellow floral pattern, plus blue slip-on shoes.","hair_color":"Light brown or dark blonde.","hairstyle":"Long, straight hair reaching past her shoulders.","identity":"A slender woman with dark skin, seen mostly from behind and in profile.","scene":"An empty paved road under a concrete overpass, with orange-and-white construction barriers, a blue directional sign, parked trucks, and trees in the background."},"uncertain":["Exact hair color (light brown vs. dark blonde) is hard to confirm under the lighting.","The woman's face is mostly turned away, so facial features are unclear."]}}

arguments.observed_change: The woman's hair changed from a high bun to a short, textured updo with loose side strands and a wavy nape, matching the reference hairstyle shape. Her hair color, clothing, pose, scene, and camera framing appear otherwise consistent.
arguments.requested_change: Change the person's hairstyle to the reference style, using the references only for shape while preserving identity, hair color, clothing, and all other video aspects.
uncertain: Exact hair color preservation is difficult to confirm under the changed lighting.
unexpected_changes: The output frames appear slightly darker and have black letterbox bars at the top and bottom compared with the source.
